analyst_view.overall: Early view: both sides play in Europe on the Thursday before (Lyon at home to Lillestrom, Monaco away at Hearts), so expect rotation and tired legs on Sunday night. Lyon (5th) were unbeaten at home in the league before the break, and Monaco (7th) have gone five league games without a win while winning every Conference League match.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. I lean lower: Lyon have conceded only nine in 10 games and Monaco's attack has stalled (13 goals, and one goal in two away defeats before the draw at Le Mans). Monaco's late return from Edinburgh adds to the case for a tight game.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.0 corners. I lean lower: Lyon average 4.6 corners and Monaco 4.1, which sums to under nine. Lyon did win eight at Brest with plenty of the ball, so nine is a fair middle.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. That looks right: Lyon (11.6 fouls a game) and Monaco (12.3) are both mid-table for fouls. Without the referee or any extra edge to the fixture, I stay with the site.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots. Season averages (Lyon 12.8, Monaco 11.7) agree, so I stay close. Rotation after the Thursday games could take a shot or two off.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Lyon average 4.6 on target and Monaco 4.2, and Lyon managed only two at Brest. Eight is a more natural figure.
